$what: Real Iowa MIS piano note (C6, mf dynamic), trimmed to 3s from onset.

recordingMeta.device: Steinway (Iowa Electronic Music Studios recording rig)
recordingMeta.$licenseNote: University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios — "without restriction" per the institution's own page, verified 2026-08-18 (docs/research/2026-08-18-w1-audio-golden-fixture-kaynaklari.md). Source AIFF SHA-256 pinned in tool/fetch_audio_fixtures.sh.

expected.$f0Derivation: 12-TET, A4=440Hz, derived from note name "C6" — not hand-typed (see frequencyForNote() in tool/prepare_audio_fixtures.dart).
expected.$onsetDerivation: Measured, not assumed: first 10ms RMS-power window exceeding -40dBFS in this recording (measureOnsetMs() in this file). Iowa MIS recordings do NOT start at the note attack — every one of these 6 fixtures has 167-560ms of leading silence, found by direct measurement, not documented anywhere upstream.
